W3Schools: tra ve gia tri cua DK dung dau tien; nhieu DK dung -> lay DK dung dau.

Thong ke co dieu kien.giai_thich: W3Schools: tinh trung binh cua vung theo 1 dieu kien dung/sai; [average_range] tuy chon.
Thong ke co dieu kien.vi_du: =AVERAGEIF(B2:B10,E3,C2:C10) — VD: trung binh Speed cua Type "Grass"

Thong ke co dieu kien.giai_thich: W3Schools: trung binh theo 1+ dieu kien (VD Type="Grass" VA Generation=1).

Dem.giai_thich: W3Schools: dem o trong trong vung; huu ich tim o thieu du lieu.
Dem.vi_du: =COUNTBLANK(C2:C21) — VD dem 8 o trong cot Type 2

Dem.giai_thich: W3Schools: dem o theo 1 dieu kien (so hoac chu). Dung $ khoa vung khi fill.
W3Schools (suy tu COUNTIF): dem theo nhieu dieu kien AND; xem them FILTER/COUNTIFS.
Dem.vi_du: =COUNTIFS(C2:C21,"Bug",E2:E21,">300") — mo rong tu VD COUNTIF W3Schools

Ngay thang.giai_thich: W3Schools: khoang cach 2 ngay theo unit "Y","M","D","MD","YM","YD"; start phai <= end (sai ra #NUM!).

Mang dong (dynamic array).giai_thich: W3Schools: tra ve cac dong thoa DK (365/2021+); nhieu DK AND dung *, OR dung +; trong -> #CALC!.

Xu ly loi.giai_thich: W3Schools: tra ve value neu khong loi, nguoc lai value_if_error; bat #N/A,#DIV/0!,#VALUE!,#REF!,#NAME?,#NUM!,#NULL!.

Thong ke.giai_thich: W3Schools: gia tri giua cua du lieu (tu sap xep); kieu trung binh mo ta trung tam.
Thong ke.vi_du: =MEDIAN(A2:G2) — tra ve gia tri o giua day so

Thong ke.giai_thich: W3Schools: so xuat hien nhieu nhat (1 so); VD tra ve 1 (xuat hien 7 lan).
Thong ke.vi_du: =MODE.SNGL(B2:E7) — dem so bong xuat hien nhieu nhat

Tai chinh.giai_thich: W3Schools: gia tri hien tai rong; rate la ty le chiet khau (VD 10%).
Tai chinh.vi_du: =NPV(10%,B2:K2) — VD ra 377,87 cho dong tien 10 nam
